ITA-9.8.2 kuṭīprāveśikarasāyanam कुटीप्रावेशिकरसयनम्
Rejuvenation therapy withlimited exposure to wind and sunlight
A rejuvenation therapy in which the patient is kept indoors in a specially designed hut and follows a specific regimen.

ITA-9.2.48 kuṭīsvedaḥ कुटीस्वेदः
Sweating induced by sitting in a heated hut or cottage
A type of sudation therapy in which diaphoresis is achieved by sitting in a specially designed cottage with a heat source outside the cottage.
